author: Dan864

title: Really nice and useful tool
body:
I really like the app. It‘s simple to set up and use and gives you a good feeling to see your progress. Can‘t wait every day to finish my exercises and tick another box. 😅 
It definitely helps staying motivated. And for those that are not (yet) motivated by just ticking boxes to remember doing your activity, setting reminders is done within seconds. 😉
Looking forward to the next update when I can mark the progress right from the widget. ✅💪🏼

author: mikehecht

title: Ausgezeichnet!
body: Nach langem Suchen ist dies die App, die endlich die Kriterien erfüllt: Optisch ansprechend, kein Schnickschnack, einfach nur Gewohnheiten tracken und graphisch aufgearbeitet anzeigen lassen. Nutze die App jetzt seit einem halben Jahr und sie ist jeden Cent wert. Die Anzeige der Streak motiviert tatsächlich, am Ball zu bleiben. Der Entwickler reagiert sehr nett auf Verbesserungsvorschläge und hat sogar einen von mir implementiert. So muss das sein!
author: BaddyBad

title: Great overview and well-designed statistics
body:
I really like the today overview and being able to see past days.

Sadly no Apple Watch app so far, maybe in the future?

Personally I would like an option to always see the last 7 days in the today view and not the last week. It‘s a little sad to see everything unchecked at the start of every week.

An option to skip days might also be nice.

One last thing, please add a field to put in a hex color code when changing colors, it‘s a pain to match color for two habits.

title: Good app but...
body:
I've bought the app for support. The thing is I have 2 reminders in 1 habit, even app is in background I don't get any reminder notifications? What's the main purpose of habit tracking app if I don't get any notifications?

Edit: Sorry, I already returned my order. It's a waste if the app doesn't deliver it's promises. Even 7 minutes workout apps shows notifications without running on background everyday on the same hour. 😕

author: Frkfrt

title: Almost Perfect 👌
body:
I love the design ne features a lot. Looks beautiful, works flawlessly. 

Kevin, maybe you could add a feature to show a more detailed calendar view when clicking on the year-grid. As for now, you can only see the streak. As an overview its a great idea which was the reason why i chosed your app over the others. I like that you show a single view for the last 365 days. If you could add the feature to be able to click on that view to open a more detailed calendar view with day names, that would make your app perfect - at least for me. 

Great work! 👌 i enjoy your app very much and bought the Premium Version without hesitation.
